lines.en: : Are you sure you’re ready to start insulting her like everything is normal again?
: Some things never change even when everything else in the world does, Ayane.
: This is but one of them.
: Do you ever get the feeling that someone’s talking about you behind your back?
: Yeah. Figure with the way I am though, it normally just means somebody is.
: You’re not that bad, Yumi. Like, yes, you’re an asshole. But you can be nice on occasion. Like how you showed up to help decorate even though you haven’t come to school in weeks.
: Ain’t like I got anythin’ else goin’ on. Chika dumped me and I ain’t got a fuckin’ clue where my mom is.
: But you so much as think about handin’ over any work I may have missed and I’m adding one more nerd to the list of girls whose teeth I’ve knocked in.
: Makoto! Where the frick are we supposed to put these ghost things? I still ain’t got any idea what we’re doin’ here!
: We can probably just throw them next to the door and sort of ease people into the scares, you know? No one is going to be afraid of these little guys.
: Just put them wherever, you two. Ayane said she doesn’t care how we handle the decorating. But people are going to start showing up any minute now and I don’t want-
: Blah, blah, blah. I’m Makoto. I like to pretend I’m an interior designer when all I really know how to do is sell dildos. Blah blah blah.
: Well, at least they’re working.
: Surprised Noriko’s still standin’, to be honest. Bitch pulled an all-nighter at the convenience store last night. Don’t think she’s slept for even a minute.
: Oh, right. You two work together now, don’t you? I thought it was weird when you showed up at the same time.
: She works. I kinda just stand there and clean tables every now and then. Barely any customers in the old district. But hey, money is money and I ain’t about to turn it down.
: Maybe that’s where this new semi-reliable side of you comes from then?
: Or maybe I’m just fuckin’ fed up with bein’ hated by everybody. Shit’s tiring. Just want that fuckin’ reset thing to happen already so some shred of normalcy comes back into my life.
: The only way that happens is if you forget about the resets entirely. Knowing they’re real sort of...changes your perspective of things in a lot of ways.
: Well, sign me the fuck up for that because I ain’t got the energy to deal with the end of the god damn world on top of all of everything else goin’ on.
: Well, what’s “everything else” exactly? As someone else that everyone in the class dislikes, maybe I can help?
: Nah, fuck off. I ain’t about to drag you into my shit too. Thanks for tryin’, though.
: I’m not trying to, like...give you a counseling session, Yumi. I just figured it might be good for you to get something off your chest to someone else who doesn’t give a shit anymore.
: You? Ain’t your whole ass thing givin’ so many shits that you become un-fucking-bearable?
: You’re thinking of old Makoto. New Makoto just wants to relax and get laid.
: Oh is that what the bondage gear is for? Kinda figured it was a costume because it’s Halloween and shit. But hey, you do you.
: I will. That’s sort of my whole policy now that I know nothing has consequences anymore.
: Well if that’s true, why the hell are you spendin’ your free time setting up some Halloween party?
: Our infinite timeline may have shaped me into someone who cares less about her future, but I am still a control freak at the end of the day. And if I didn’t volunteer to do this, no one would have.
: Don’t see how that matters but, again, you do you.
: What will you do, though? Now that you know about stuff, I mean.
: More of the same, I guess? Lay low until the world blows up? I don’t know — what am I supposed to do?
: That depends on what you want, I guess. Given what’s happened in the past, it’s highly probable that your mind won’t even survive the reset again.
: Okay. The fuck’s that supposed to mean, though?
: That you can basically do anything you want and then not have to worry about regretting it since you’ll forget once things start over. Probably.
: Probably?
: I don’t really get how it works either. I just know some information stays and some goes. But you can ask me again for a clearer answer several loops from now if we’re both still ourselves.
: And if we ain’t?
: Then we’ll probably just keep reliving freshman year of high school over and over until someone figures out how to break us out. If we even can break out. But honestly, what’s even the point?
: Not bein’ a teenager anymore. This shit sucks.

: Maybe for you. But life doesn’t get any easier as you get older. Responsibilities multiply, expectations multiply, pressure multiplies — and you just have to lie there and take it because you’re an “adult.”
: At least when we’re young, we can fall back on that fact. We don’t have to be perfect because no one expects us to be. It’s the best time to do stupid stuff and make stupid mistakes.

: But the thing with me is I’ve always been so focused on the future that I didn’t leave any room to make those mistakes. Which effectively robbed me of what are supposed to be the best years of my life.
: So...just to make sure I’m understandin’ shit, you’re sayin’ that now that you ain’t gotta worry about growin’ up, you can just...chill? Am I gettin’ that right?

: Pretty much, yeah. And I think you can benefit from doing the same thing, Yumi. Which isn’t to say I think you’ve put any amount of thought into your future to begin with. But now, you don’t have to.
: That’s why I will not be giving you any of the work you’ve missed out on during your prolonged absence since it literally does not matter. But old Makoto would have because she sucked.
: Well, damn. Maybe this shit ain’t that bad then. And maybe new Makoto ain’t that bad either.
: That just depends on your definition of “bad.” Because having a lack of consequences makes me more brazen as well. And I would now gladly throw anyone under the bus so long as it will benefit me.
: That ain’t bad either. That’s how shit should be. Ain’t nobody else gonna matter in the long run, so livin’ for yourself is all you can really do.
: No, you’re not getting it. Nobody else matters because there is no long run. There is here and now. But we’ll be right back here again. That’s why I stopped caring.
MAKOTO FINALLY FINISHES POSITIONING THE PUMPKIN THING AND STANDS UP WOW THAT TOOK A LONG TIME
: Take Sensei for example. Under normal circumstances, I’d try to keep the fact that I have screwed him six ways from Sunday a secret from you.
: Ew, what the fuck?!
: But now, I don’t care if you know because it isn’t going to negatively affect anything! Everyone can find out about me and the only impact will be short term effects, not long term ones.
: So yes, you might hit me a few times. But that would be a brand new experience I’d have never had if it weren’t for the confidence this world has given me! I can do so much experimenting now!
: So...you really have been hookin’ up with that guy then?
: Oh yeah. Since even before I knew about the loops. So suffice it to say, I don’t care much about “safe” sex anymore.
: And you ain’t even a little embarrassed to just outright admit that?
: Nope. Having all the time in the world to be embarrassed has, weirdly enough, made it hard to feel embarrassed about anything at all. I love this.
: I’m not sure what reaction I was expecting from you, but this definitely isn’t it.
: The old you really wasn’t that bad, Makoto.
: I know we ain’t ever been friends and shit, but I’ve always thought it was impressive how you could, like...be all responsible and whatnot. And I know you helped cover up my absences, so...
: I just think it’s kinda shitty that it took some crazy supernatural shit to make you feel less...pressure or whatever.
: And I obviously ain’t gonna tell you how you should be livin’ your life- especially if you’re finally enjoyin’ yourself now. I just...
: It doesn’t...feel good...playin’ with other people’s feelings to try and boost your own self-esteem. And even if there ain’t gonna be any long-term consequences if you do that now...it still sucks.
: And if you’re just gonna do that shit to “experiment” or whatever...I really will kick your ass.
: Wow.
: Wow what?
: I’m just thinking of how powerful time loops really are if they can turn me into the bad guy and you into the adorable good one.
: That was so cute that I’d hug you if it wouldn’t immediately result in my neck being snapped.
: I’m only sayin’ that shit in the first place since I know I ain’t gonna remember it if I do get sent back again. That was embarrassing as fuck.
: For now. But like I said, you’ll quickly come to learn that the longer this drags on, the harder it is to feel that way.
: Every day, things feel less real. I start each morning the same way...and I end each night the same way.
: And while that’s no different from my morning and night rituals when I wasn’t a perpetual high-schooler, it’s so much easier to do now that I know it won’t suddenly be ten years later one day.
: Because that’s always been the fear — holding my breath for so long that my life has just passed by without even realizing it. And that’s not scary anymore either. I’m not going anywhere.
: But-
: All that stuff about me throwing people under the bus to make myself feel better? That isn’t going to actually happen. It’s all talk. I’m trying to convince myself that that’s who I am.
: But when you peel off this bondage suit, I’m still the same control-freak I’ve always been. I still can’t help but care, even if it’s for people I don’t necessarily care about.
: The only difference is I’m a little more honest now. But that’s more about being honest with myself than it is about being honest with people like you.
: Once more — the fuck is any of that supposed to mean?
: Don’t worry about it, Yumi. I won’t bore you with any more unwanted apocalyptic advice. The best course of action will always be figuring out what you want to do with that time. Not someone else.
: I am now harnessing the power of new Makoto to give you my blessing.
: What blessing? The fuck are you talkin’ about?
: To do whatever you want. Or...whoever you want.

: Y...You fuckin’...I ain’t a fuckin’ moron, Makoto! I know what you’re insinuatin’ there! And it’s the same damn thing that’s made shit so fucking...shitty for me lately! There ain’t anybody I want to do!
: Okaaaaay. But it’s the best possible time to try it out since there’s a chance you won’t even remember it in the future! Your brain could turn back into soup any day now!
: My brain ain’t soup! And I ain’t about to spend the beginning of a potentially infinite life spreading my legs for some dude who should’ve been behind bars years ago if what you say is true!
: What will you do then, Yumi? Will it really be “more of the same” like you said? Or will you actually try to venture outside of the box now that you know there isn’t anything dangerous out there?
: More of the same. Exactly like I said. This shit’s just a vacation as far as I’m concerned. So you can go ahead and keep being a fucking loser and I’ll keep being a fucking asshole. End of story.
: Middle of story. There’s no ending in sight here.
: That might be true for now, but-
: Fuck off, Makoto.
: I see that the...strange...egg...things from the last Halloween party have...made a comeback.
: Target identified — large skull. Possibly real. Primed for collecting. Goal — find a ladder. Bonus objective — don’t let Ayane find out.
: There’s a ladder over here, Rin. Just be careful. Miku already knocked one of the skeletons over earlier.
: Chika! Futaba! Help me move the ladder and we can all take turns with the skull!
: Take turns...doing what exactly?
: Exactly!
: ...What?
: Can you two handle it on your own, Rin? There’s...something I’ve gotta do first.
: Hm? I mean...we can try. But you’re the strong one here. Futaba and I only equal like one third of a Chika in power. And even less in sex appeal.
: Sex appeal doesn’t move ladders, Rin.
: Not with that attitude, it doesn’t! Come on, Futaba! Let’s seduce a ladder!
